TC_SCHEME_016.description: 预览不存在的方案删除影响，返回 404 SCHEME_NOT_FOUND

TC_SCHEME_017.title: POST /api/evaluation-schemes/{id}/clone_克隆已发布方案_返回新DRAFT草稿
TC_SCHEME_017.description: 克隆已发布方案为新草稿，新方案状态为 DRAFT、版本号自动递增，子选择深拷贝

TC_SCHEME_018.title: POST /api/evaluation-schemes/{id}/clone_克隆DRAFT草稿_返回409
TC_SCHEME_018.description: 克隆 DRAFT 状态草稿，违反业务规则【来源限制：仅 PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED 可克隆】，返回 409 SCHEME_409_STATUS

TC_SCHEME_019.title: POST /api/evaluation-schemes/{id}/archive_归档已发布方案_返回ARCHIVED
TC_SCHEME_019.description: 显式归档已发布方案，状态流转 → ARCHIVED；前置确保删除影响预览（TC_SCHEME_015）已在发布态执行

TC_SCHEME_020.title: POST /api/evaluation-schemes/{id}/archive_已归档再次归档_返回409
TC_SCHEME_020.description: 对已归档方案再次归档，违反业务规则【幂等性：已归档方案再次归档 → 409】，返回 SCHEME_409_STATUS

TC_SCHEME_021.title: DELETE /api/evaluation-schemes/{id}_删除未引用DRAFT草稿_物理删除
TC_SCHEME_021.description: 删除克隆出的未引用 DRAFT 草稿，按删除决策逻辑【DRAFT 未引用 → 物理删除】，action=PHYSICALLY_DELETED

TC_SCHEME_022.title: DELETE /api/evaluation-schemes/{id}_删除已归档方案_返回409
TC_SCHEME_022.description: 删除已归档方案，违反业务规则【幂等性：已归档方案再次删除 → 409】，返回 SCHEME_ALREADY_ARCHIVED
